scripts.text:
[ Tournament Receptionist ]
Geffen Magic Tournament is being held once every 3 years.
scripts.translation:
[大赛接待员]
吉芬魔法大赛每三年举办一次。

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Receptionist ]
This festival used to be a more studious event with scholars discussing magical methods.
Now it's all about fun and a big party.
scripts.translation:
[大赛接待员]
这个庆典过去更偏重学术，学者们会聚在一起探讨魔法技法。
如今倒成了一场热闹的大聚会。

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Receptionist ]
Now it has become almost exclusively a fighting tournament.
The most famous Mages from all over the world come for the tournament.
scripts.translation:
[大赛接待员]
现在，它几乎完全变成了格斗比赛。
世界各地最有名的魔法师都会来参赛。

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Receptionist ]
Anything else?
scripts.translation:
[大赛接待员]
还有其他问题吗？

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Receptionist ]
There is no registration fee to enter.
The only requirement is to pass a simple test.
scripts.translation:
[大赛接待员]
参赛不收报名费，只需要通过一个简单的测试。

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Receptionist ]
The test is very simple. Defeat a Desert Wolf in 60 seconds or less and you're in.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Receptionist ]

Do you want to take the test?

Tournament!

scripts.translation:
[吉芬魔法学院院长]
我是A组的主持人，吉芬魔法学院院长~！
大魔导师赞扎巴尔·赫尔莫德！

scripts.text:
[ Geffen Academy Master ]
I am honored to be this year's MC.
Now, it's time for the matches to begin.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬魔法学院院长]
很荣幸能担任今年的主持人。
现在，比赛即将开始。

scripts.text:
[ Geffen Academy Master ]
Ahem...
scripts.translation:
[吉芬魔法学院院长]
咳咳...

scripts.text: Leave the Arena and receive your reward
scripts.translation: 离开竞技场并领取奖励

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Guide ]
You won the competition!
Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[大赛向导]
您赢得了比赛！
恭喜！

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Guide ]
By the way, the Academy Master has
something to tell you!
scripts.translation:
[大赛向导]
顺便说一下，学院大师有话要对您说！

scripts.text:
[ Geffen Academy Master ]
Congratulations!
This has been the best pool of
competitors in the history of this
competition.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬魔法学院院长]
恭喜！
这届选手的实力，是历届大赛中最强的。

scripts.text:
[ Geffen Academy Master ]
I present to you your earned ^55CC55Geffen
Magic Tournament Coins.^000000
scripts.translation:
[吉芬魔法学院院长]
这是您赢得的^55CC55吉芬魔法大赛硬币。^000000

scripts.text:
[ Geffen Academy Master ]
Bring the coins to the ^55CC55Geffen Coin
Operator^000000 to exchange for special
equipment.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬魔法学院院长]
带着硬币去找^55CC55吉芬硬币兑换员^000000，就能兑换特殊装备。

scripts.text:
[ Geffen Academy Master ]
Your name will be remembered in the
history books of Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬魔法学院院长]
您的名字将被载入吉芬史册。

scripts.text:
[ Geffen Academy Master ]
Congratulations again.
I hope you enjoy the rest of the
Geffen Festivities.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬魔法学院院长]
再次恭喜您。
希望您接下来也能尽情享受吉芬的庆典。

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Guide ]
Congratulations! You've defeated every other opponent in Group A! Good luck on the final!
scripts.translation:
[大赛向导]
恭喜！您击败了A组的所有对手！
祝您在决赛中好运！

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Guide ]
Congratulations on winning the {0}st round!
scripts.translation:
[大赛向导]
恭喜你赢得第{0}轮比赛！

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Guide ]
Congratulations on winning the {0}nd round!
scripts.translation:
[大赛向导]
恭喜你赢得第{0}轮比赛！

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Guide ]
Congratulations on winning the {0}th round!
scripts.translation:
[大赛向导]
恭喜你赢得第{0}轮比赛！

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Guide ]
Congratulations on winning the {0}rd round!
scripts.translation:
[大赛向导]
恭喜你赢得第{0}轮比赛！

scripts.text: Begin the final match.
scripts.translation: 开始决赛

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text: Begin the {0}st match.
scripts.translation: 开始第{0}场比赛

scripts.text: Begin the {0}nd match.
scripts.translation: 开始第{0}场比赛

scripts.text: Begin the {0}th match.
scripts.translation: 开始第{0}场比赛

scripts.text: Begin the {0}rd match.
scripts.translation: 开始第{0}场比赛

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Guide ]
Winners of each round will receive ^55CC55Geffen Magic Tournament Coins^000000 as a reward.
scripts.translation:
[大赛向导]
每轮比赛的获胜者将获得^55CC55吉芬魔法大赛硬币^000000作为奖励。

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Guide ]
Bring the coins to the ^55CC55Geffen Coin Operator^000000 to exchange them for special equipment.
scripts.translation:
[大赛向导]
带着硬币去找^55CC55吉芬硬币兑换员^000000，就能兑换特殊装备。

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Guide ]
The {0}st match of Group A is about to begin!
scripts.translation:
[大赛向导]
A组第{0}场比赛即将开始！

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Guide ]
The {0}nd match of Group A is about to begin!
scripts.translation:
[大赛向导]
A组第{0}场比赛即将开始！

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Guide ]
The {0}th match of Group A is about to begin!
scripts.translation:
[大赛向导]
A组第{0}场比赛即将开始！

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Guide ]
The {0}rd match of Group A is about to begin!
scripts.translation:
[大赛向导]
A组第{0}场比赛即将开始！

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Guide ]
Need more time to prepare I see.
Not a problem, talk to me when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[大赛向导]
看来您还需要更多时间准备。
没关系，准备好后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Healer ]
The previous round's winner can receive a heal from me.
scripts.translation:
[大赛治疗师]
上一轮的获胜者可以来找我治疗。

scripts.text: Heal
scripts.translation: 接受治疗

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Healer ]
Guess you don't need to be healed.
scripts.translation:
[大赛治疗师]
看来您不需要治疗。

scripts.text:
[ Tournament Healer ]
Enjoy.
Good luck on the next round!
scripts.translation:
[大赛治疗师]
好了。
祝您下一轮好运！

scripts.text:
[ Loki ]
That's a pretty good score.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
成绩相当不错。

scripts.text:
[ Loki ]
Please take this present.
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
请收下这份礼物。

scripts.text:
[ Loki ]
Let's take a rain check on our match.
We'll fight next time we meet...
scripts.translation:
[洛基]
我们的比赛改日再约吧。
下次见面时再一决高下...

scripts.text:
[ Lydia ]
Good game~!
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
打得真棒~！

scripts.text:
[ Lydia ]
I want to give you a reward even if you lost~!
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
虽然你输了，但我还是想给你一份奖励~！

scripts.text:
[ Lydia ]
I hope to see you again.
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
希望下次还能见到你。

scripts.text:
[ Iris ]
I enjoyed watching your round~
Bad luck this year huh?~
Wish you luck next year.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
你的比赛看得我很过瘾~
今年运气不太好，是吧？~
祝你明年好运。

scripts.text:
[ Iris ]
Take this to cheer you up.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
收下这个，希望能让你开心一点。

scripts.text:
[ Iris ]
Think we'll meet again?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
我们还会再见面吗？

scripts.text:
[ Chaos ]
That was a good match~!
Not bad at all~!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
这是一场精彩的比赛~！
表现相当不错~！

scripts.text:
[ Chaos ]
You have been very impressive today.
I want to give you a present~!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
你今天的表现真让人印象深刻。
我想送你一份礼物~！

scripts.text:
[ Chaos ]
I hope to see you again next time~!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
希望下次还能再见到你~！

scripts.text:
[ Fenrir ]
It was a good game.
Hope you get farther next time.
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
打得不错。
希望下次你能晋级到更后面的轮次。

scripts.text:
[ Fenrir ]
Take this gift.
Keep trying harder~!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
收下这份礼物。
继续加油~！

scripts.text:
[ Fenrir ]
I hope to see you again adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[芬里尔]
希望下次还能见到你，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Are you okay?
There have been so many jerks everywhere we go...
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
你没事吧？
我们不管走到哪里，都碰到这么多讨厌的家伙...

scripts.text:
[Kafra]
Thanks for helping me out.
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉]
谢谢你帮了我。
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Iris]
I am Iris~
I am travelling with my good friend Chaos~!
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
我是艾莉丝~
我正和我的好朋友混沌一起旅行~！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
I am not the one you should thank.
Thank that adventurer, {0}.
It could have been much worse.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
别谢我，应该谢谢那位冒险者{0}。
要不是这位冒险者，情况可能会糟得多。

scripts.text:
[Kafra]
Thank you {0}.
You saved me.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉]
谢谢你，{0}。
你救了我。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
It's pretty rare to meet someone as righteous as {0}.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
像{0}这样正直的人，真是难得一见。

scripts.text:
[Iris]
I'm on my way to see the Geffen Magic Tournament with Chaos.
Are you on your way there too, {0}?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
我正和混沌一起去看吉芬魔法大赛。
{0}，你也是去那里的吗？

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Yes, you seem strong enough to be in the Tournament.
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
嗯，看你的实力，应该能参加大赛。

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
Just know that Fenrir plans on joining as well, so it won't be that easy.
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
不过，芬里尔也打算参赛，想获胜可没那么容易。

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
This is my favorite magic buff scroll, so take it as a token of our appreciation.
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
这是我最喜欢的魔法增益卷轴，请收下，以表谢意。

scripts.text:
[Chaos]
It will be useful in the Magic Tournament.
Let's go Iris~!
It's going to start soon~!
scripts.translation:
[混沌]
这在魔法大赛中会很有用。
走吧，艾莉丝~！
比赛马上就要开始了~！

scripts.text:
[Iris]
Yes~! Go {0}~
Kafra, wish us luck~!
Do your best {1}.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉丝]
好~！加油，{0}~
卡普拉，祝我们好运~！
{1}，加油哦。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
My monthly salary...
What am I gonna do?
I have to eat...
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
我的月薪...
我该怎么办？
我得吃饭啊...

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
You're not a thief are you?
I don't know what to do about my zeny being stolen.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
你不会是小偷吧？
我的Zeny被偷了，我都不知道该怎么办了。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Woo, yeah, what a day~
It seems like all these thieves in Geffen are rich.
They may be good at stealing but they're easy to steal from too.
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
哇，今天可真不错~
吉芬这些小偷还挺有钱的。
他们虽然很会偷东西，可要从他们身上偷东西，也容易得很。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Hey, why are you crying?
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
嘿，你为什么在哭？
发生什么事了？

scripts.text: You tell Lydia about the shoplifters.
scripts.translation: 你把那些商店窃贼的事告诉了莉迪亚。

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
What am I going to do?
*sobbing*
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
我该怎么办？
*抽泣*

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
(I stole this envelope from one of those thug-looking guys)
....
How much zeny was stolen from you?
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
（这个信封是我从一个看起来像恶棍的家伙身上偷来的。）
...
你被偷了多少Zeny？

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
1,000,000 zeny!
It's everything that I had.
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
1,000,000 Zeny！
那是我的全部积蓄。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Whoa! That's the same amount as what's in this envelope that I stole from that shoplifter.
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
哇！正好跟我从那个商店窃贼身上偷来的信封里的钱一样多。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Maybe this is what you are looking for?
Check it out!
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
也许这就是你在找的东西？
看看这个！

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
Let me see...
Wait, this has to be my zeny!
Thank you very much for finding it!
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
让我看看...
等等，这一定是我的Zeny！
非常感谢你帮我找到它！

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Well... Um, that is...
I didn't say I was gonna give it back to you...
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
呃...那个...
我可没说要把钱还给你...

scripts.text:
[Geffen Resident]
Thank you very much!!
I will never forget your kindness~!
I'm putting it in the bank right now!
Have a good day~!!! Zap~!!
scripts.translation:
[吉芬居民]
太感谢了！！
我永远不会忘记你的恩情~！
我这就去银行把钱存起来！
祝你今天愉快~！！！嗖~！！

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
......
I guess... I did a good thing...?
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
...
我这算是...做了件好事...？

scripts.text: You tell Lydia about your stolen zeny.
scripts.translation: 你把自己的Zeny被偷的事告诉了莉迪亚。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
So, are you asking me for more zeny?
Zeny doesn't grow on trees you know!
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
所以，你还想让我给你更多Zeny？
Zeny可不会从天上掉下来！

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
I mean it is hers so...
I'll just consider it a donation to the Geffen Magic Tournament.
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
毕竟，那本来就是她的钱嘛...
就当我为吉芬魔法大赛捐款了。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
Well, I can't give away any Tournament participants any zeny...
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
不过，我可不能给大赛参赛者送钱...

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
I stole this magic scroll from another thief, so don't worry about taking it.
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
这张魔法卷轴是我从另一个盗贼那里偷来的，所以你就放心拿去吧。

scripts.text:
[Lydia]
I need to get to the Geffen Magic Tournament.
Gotta go!
scripts.translation:
[莉迪亚]
我得赶去吉芬魔法大赛了。
走了！
